Looking for a job where you can grow, work with modern technology, and make a real difference every day? Join DHL Supply Chain in Wijchen/Nijmegen and become part of a team that keeps essential products moving around the world. Wie zoeken we? You don’t need years of experience, we’re looking for the right attitude. You speak Dutch or English You’re motivated and enjoy practical, hands-on work You’re accurate and responsible You’re willing to learn and develop yourself You’re able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) You’re comfortable working in a dynamic logistics environment Wat bieden wij je? At DHL, you’ll get more than just a job. You’ll have the opportunity to develop yourself while working for one of the world’s leading logistics companies. Monthly salary of €2630,88 Full-time or part-time working options Extra bonuses for overtime and evening shifts from 18:00 onwards 8.33% holiday allowance Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per day Opportunities to obtain valuable logistics certifications Pension accrual after 8 working weeks Opportunities for career development and internal growth Possibility of a permanent contract Functieomschrijving At DHL, you’re not just another employee. You’ll work in a modern, clean, and high-tech logistics environment where teamwork, quality, and accuracy are key. You’ll handle a wide range of products, including important pharmaceutical goods. Your work helps ensure that essential and sometimes life-saving products reach the people who need them, making your contribution truly meaningful. Whether you’re looking for a full-time or part-time job, this could be your next step. Your role as a Logistics Operator As a Logistics Operator, you make sure customer orders are processed accurately and ready to leave the warehouse on time. Your day is varied, active, and hands-on. Your responsibilities include: Picking and preparing customer orders for shipment Checking, counting, and managing inventory Printing labels and preparingpackages Processing returns accurately Packing shipments and preparing them for transport Following DHL’s quality, safety, and hygiene procedures You don’t need previous logistics experience. We’ll teach you everything you need to know. Because you’ll be working with pharmaceutical products, you’ll receive thorough training and guidance from day one. Grow with DHL At DHL, your development matters. Once you’ve mastered your role, there are opportunities to expand your skills and take additional training or certifications, such as: EPT Forklift Reach truck OPT And if you’re ambitious, there are opportunities to grow into positions with more responsibility, such as Team Leader. Excited? So are we! Send your questions via WhatsApp or apply directly with the button. We can’t wait to hear from you and welcome you to DHL Supply Chain.
